title: gfx938 target admission omits device-executed register broadcasts and resident scans
executor_revision: existing per-user bw1100-bench HCU gateway; component qualification, not a canonical Lab Executor
observation: The current exact gfx938 Target refused 25 typed register-value Schedules with TARGET_OPERATION_UNSUPPORTED. A separate explicit proposed Target with the same route, dtype, resource and instruction facts verified and emitted those Schedules; 63 exact device checks passed. This establishes a bounded Target-admission omission, rather than a missing generic layout algebra or a whole-task performance ceiling.
proposed_change: Declare coordinate, compare, select, broadcast_in_dim and resident scan in the exact gfx938 document; retain five reachable Corpus cases and dtype/shape/effect counterexamples. Preserve the original188 expectations and all frozen campaigns. Shared primitive semantics/schema/effects/work stay on the shared branch.
